entities.name: Sami
entities.description: Captain of the Seriema who flies through a war zone to Infinite Guideline, tells Pinnacle the truth, and reveals they were kitchen help on the Wurm Speaker.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Sami's Kav first mate who presents Pinnacle with a recording of the Kavaron atrocity.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A Monoist apostate who broadcasts a plea to the Monoists and tries to guess a warp ferry code with Haliya.

entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: A Sunstar squire who broadcasts to the Free Company that she has detached from Vondam's command, then helps Alpharael try to steal a ferry and meets Vondam again.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: A Solar Knight who appears on Infinite Guideline's control deck and calls Haliya home.

entities.name: Mantis
entities.description: A Eumidian Pinnacle officer on Infinite Guideline who receives Sami's testimony and recommends handing the stone to the Drix.

entities.name: Barrow
entities.description: A Drix aboard Infinite Guideline who plays the qalib of Sentinelle au Batardeau and is arming itself.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A wizard aboard the Seriema whom Sami expects might cast a spell against mass leeches.

entities.name: Walker
entities.description: A Sunstar knight who may be dying in the battle.

entities.name: Quinidad
entities.description: A Sunstar squire who may be dying in the battle.

entities.name: The Endstone
entities.description: A causality-bending stone that both fleets are fighting over.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Sami's ship, which is placed under tacit arrest at Infinite Guideline.

entities.name: Candela
entities.description: The Sunstar ship of Syr Vondam.

entities.name: Wurm Speaker
entities.description: A ship that went to speak to the voices in the Wurmwall and mostly did not return; Sami was kitchen help aboard.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline
entities.description: The Pinnacle station and eternity-column gateway besieged by the Free Company and Monoist fleets.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The system the fleets contest.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: A storm giant toward which a drumship flees.

entities.name: Susur Secundi
entities.description: The Monoist home from which smaller vessels come.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The Kav world where the atrocity occurred.

entities.name: Taro-duend
entities.description: The Kav town whose people died protecting Sami's crew.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: The debris cloud where the voices Sami visited are.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The neutral administrators of Infinite Guideline who guarantee safety but do not take sides.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Palatinate fleet attacking Infinite Guideline.

entities.name: Monoism
entities.description: The faith whose fleet and gravliner contest Infinite Guideline.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: The people who gave star travel to Pinnacle and are considered the only ones trusted to contain the Endstone.

entities.name: Myzoformines
entities.description: Monoist mass-leech creatures that attack slow, close targets near Infinite Guideline.

entities.name: Looping aliens
aliases: the myzoformines that are not myzoformines
entities.description: Looping squid-armed beings of strange topology that enter Infinite Guideline through holes shot in the hull and reduce a war mechan to a chalky graph.

entities.name: Mallowmass
entities.description: Pinnacle's custom of guest protection that Sami declines to claim.

entities.name: The Sum
entities.description: The Sunstar principle of maximizing life that Haliya doubts.

entities.name: Grand Cosmocordance
entities.description: A Sunstar theory that the future is not yet real, which Haliya invokes in argument.

events.summary: Alpharael identifies a mass leech called a myzoformine approaching the Seriema.
events.quote: A mass leech. Sometimes they just point you out for investigation. Sometimes they kill you.

events.summary: The Seriema falls toward Infinite Guideline at fifty kilometers a second.
events.quote: They are falling toward the Infinite Guideline , glittering all alone in the dark, at a handsome fifty kilometers a second.

events.summary: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company bid with speed to reach Infinite Guideline.
events.quote: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company are in a bidding war, and they are paying with speed.

events.summary: Haliya reluctantly aligns her Sunstar frequency-hopper so the Seriema can listen to Free Company traffic.
events.quote: It takes some verbal fencing before Haliya is willing to align her Sunstar Company frequency-hopper with the Seriema 's receiver.

events.summary: The crew watches a distant space battle in which a ship is hit.
events.quote: Someone was hit, and died, or lived.

events.summary: Pinnacle lases the shadow shields of palestars braking too close, and the Monoists kill them.
events.quote: A pair of Sunstar patrol ships try to brake too close to Guideline, and Pinnacle shows its teeth

events.summary: Sami sends a recorded message to Infinite Guideline offering information and requesting guidance.
events.quote: We are inbound. We offer gifts of information and request your guidance.

events.summary: Alpharael broadcasts to the Monoists that he carries a thing sent by INEVITA and asks help reaching the warp.
events.quote: I am Alpharael of Secundi, kamu-shiku, chosen by the singularity.

events.summary: Haliya agonizes over broadcasting and reveals she planted two bombs on the ship.
events.quote: I have two bombs on the ship,

events.summary: Alpharael persuades Haliya to keep her word and make the broadcast.
events.quote: Maybe you aren't cut out to be a Sunstar knight, Haliya. Maybe you aren't cut out to be certain of everything.

events.summary: Tannuk reveals the crew had already found and thrown out Haliya's bombs.
events.quote: We found them while the Illvoi were refitting the fusion engine and threw them out.

events.summary: Haliya broadcasts to the Free Company that she has detached from Vondam's command and offers the artifact on Infinite Guideline.
events.quote: I have detached myself from Syr Vondam's command and placed myself on errantry.

events.summary: The fighting continues around but does not touch the Seriema.
events.quote: But the fighting does not touch the Seriema.

events.summary: Sami declines to ask for mallowmass so that Infinite Guideline is not put at risk.
events.quote: We are under other protection.

events.summary: Sami says their plan with Pinnacle is to tell the whole truth.
events.quote: So, I'm going to tell them the truth. All of it.

events.summary: Sami reveals they were kitchen help on the Wurm Speaker, which went to the voices in the Wurmwall and mostly did not return.
events.quote: I was kitchen help. Not a lot of people came back.

events.summary: The Seriema reaches Infinite Guideline.
events.quote: They make it to Infinite Guideline .

events.summary: A ceasefire lets both sides crowd toward Infinite Guideline to receive the Endstone and destroy pursuers.
events.quote: Under cover of a ceasefire—to retrieve survivors, make repairs, and limp away—both sides crowd in toward Infinite Guideline, waiting to receive the Endstone from the Seriema and destroy its pursuers.

events.summary: Pinnacle places the Seriema under tacit arrest.
events.quote: The Seriema is under tacit arrest.

events.summary: Sami meets Checkmate Mantis on the dock.
events.quote: "You must be Checkmate Mantis," Sami says

events.summary: Sami tells Mantis the whole story of the artifact unearthed at Sigma.
events.quote: I have come into possession of an artifact unearthed from the clay of Sigma.

events.summary: Tannuk presents a memory crystal with the Seriema's full recording of Kavaron.
events.quote: Tannuk takes a knee and presents, in an outstretched claw, a quartz memory crystal.

events.summary: Mantis reveals Vondam came to confess and warn Pinnacle about the battle over the Endstone.
events.quote: Syr Vondam came to us to confess his crimes and warn us to evacuate Infinite Guideline .

events.summary: Mantis says the artifact should be given to the Drix.
events.quote: I mean the Drix.

events.summary: Mantis reveals that a Drix named Barrow arrived two days ago.
events.quote: A Drix seamed in two days ago.

events.summary: Mantis admits Vondam persuaded her lethal force might be justified but she has not used it.
events.quote: Checkmate Mantis draws a long, low drone from her legs. "Yes."

events.summary: The dock loses power and light as an unseen attack pierces it.
events.quote: The lights go out. The air pumps stop. The dock plunges into darkness.

events.summary: Sonar shows the dock has been holed in many places by tiny punctures.
events.quote: The dock has been holed in several places.

events.summary: Mantis identifies potential matter being pumped into the station.
events.quote: "Potential matter," Checkmate Mantis says.

events.summary: Haliya and Alpharael, drifting toward the tug quay in armor, find the warp ferries are gone.
events.quote: I don't want to declare defeat too soon. But the ferries are gone.

events.summary: Infinite Guideline springs leaks and loses its aurorae as Monoist mechans dock at punctures.
events.quote: Infinite Guideline has just sprung leaks. A lot of leaks.

events.summary: Solar Knights launch lightbridge boarding craft at Guideline.
events.quote: The Solar Knights are making a play for Guideline.

events.summary: Haliya spots a many-limbed shape headed for the dock where the Seriema is moored.
events.quote: It has a lot of limbs.

events.summary: A looping, topologically strange alien enters the dock through a hole.
events.quote: It is beautiful. It is a loop. It has no inside or outside.

events.summary: Mantis orders self-defense and the mechans shred the alien, which recovers.
events.quote: "Sanctioned self-defense!" Mantis orders, and the mechans open fire.

events.summary: The alien licks a war mechan clean, graphing its components into chalky lattice.
events.quote: It licks the mechan clean.

events.summary: Haliya and Alpharael crash into the tug quay and enter the station.
events.quote: They crash into the tug quay and stick.

events.summary: Alpharael recites random numbers hoping the Endstone will make his guess a correct ferry code, and it is rejected.
events.quote: You thought you'd guess randomly, then, in the future, you'd get the Endstone and make your guess correct!

events.summary: Haliya insists on returning to the Free Company to report and beg Alpharael's pardon.
events.quote: I'm going to make my report and beg your pardon.

events.summary: Vondam appears on the control deck and says he acted in accordance with the Sum except when he let Haliya go out of love.
events.quote: I did act in accordance with the Sum. Except when I let you go. I did that out of love.

events.summary: Vondam, helmet open and bladiators ready, stands between them and the airlock.
events.quote: He is here. Standing on the far side of the control deck. Between them and the airlock.

events.summary: Vondam calls on Haliya to come home and take the Endstone.
events.quote: Come home, Haliya.

relations.note: Haliya is Vondam's squire, though she has detached from his command.
relations.quote: This is Haliya, squire to Syr Vondam of the Candela .

relations.note: The two fleets are in a bidding war for Infinite Guideline.
relations.quote: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company are in a bidding war, and they are paying with speed.

relations.note: Barrow is a Drix aboard Infinite Guideline.
relations.quote: A Drix seamed in two days ago.

relations.note: Sami was kitchen help on the Wurm Speaker.
Haliya says she needs someone to protect.
relations.quote: I need somebody to protect, or I don't know what to do.
